_comment: Sessions the automatic publication must never consider, with the reason each
one is here. Read by scripts/autopublish.py and enforced in
app/services/autopublish.py; edited by hand, reviewed like code.
This is the escape hatch, not the main mechanism. A session OpenF1 marks
is_cancelled is excluded automatically and does not belong in this file —
the two below are listed anyway, because the flag is a field on a third
party's API and a file in this repo is the thing we control. If OpenF1 ever
flips them back, the list still holds.
Add a session here when it will never settle and the reason is known: a
cancelled race, a session OpenF1 published under a key it later abandoned,
a test session. Do not add one that is merely slow — that is what the
readiness check is for, and hiding it here loses the race.
Closing the GitHub issue is NOT how a session is silenced. The issue comes
back on the next run, by design: an unexplained stuck session should keep
asking. This file is how it stops.

excluded.label: Sakhir 2026 · Race
excluded.reason: Cancelled. OpenF1 /sessions returns is_cancelled: true, and the session has zero laps and no CHEQUERED FLAG in race_control. There is no race to analyse.
